title: Clinical Knowledge Graph Construction and Evaluation with Multi-LLMs via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Udiptaman Das; Krishnasai B. Atmakuri; Duy Ho; Chi Lee; Yugyung Lee
why_relevant: Uses multi-LLM consensus and entropy-based scoring for clinical KG construction, touching on hallucination detection, but is an application paper not focused on RAG robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific KG construction pipeline; does not study retrieval noise, conflict, attacks, or calibration in a generalizable way.
